agent_explanation: Single-body drop onto floor boundary violates energy conservation. At step 60 body is inbound vy=-18.67 with total energy ~3017 J (near E0=3017.99). Collision handling at step 61 produces outbound vy=+19.73, energy 3363 J > allowed 3324.78. Expected e=0.907 should reduce speed to ~16.9 m/s, but speed increased to 19.73, indicating impulse or positional correction adds energy instead of dissipating. Lowering e to 0.5 removes violation.
